headline: William Jewell's first win comes against winless Harding
dek: William Jewell had lost all five of their matches before Harding came to visit, and the win is their first of the season. Harding arrived without a win of their own and leave without one, having now lost every match they have played.
displaced_by: results night: William Jewell's first win of the season, at home to Harding, after five defeats
